title: Remember gate
summary: An episode is stored only when remember is explicit. Withdrawal hides episodes and diary rows in an archive and leaves world cards searchable.
body: HORBM research note R3, 2026-11-18, kept episodes off disk until remember. Owner decision, Mate, 2026-11-18: consent withdrawal hides and archives stored rows. It does not delete them. The RAM ring is cleared. World cards stay searchable.

sources.title: Galion Labs, HORBM R3 memory, persona, empathy, 2026-11-18
